description: Manual gates for the Collaborative VR + web accounts track (docs/BUILD_PLAN.md steps 13-29). These are facts no script can detect (dashboard setup, on-device tests). scripts/check_collab_gates.py reads this file.
rules: An agent may set a gate to true ONLY after the user explicitly confirms it in the conversation. Never flip a gate to unblock yourself.
When setting a gate to true, fill confirmed_by (the person's role, e.g. 'user') and confirmed_on (YYYY-MM-DD).
No secrets in this file. App IDs, publishable keys and URLs are public values and belong in the config described in the collab-vr-accounts-and-gates skill.

scope_approved.meaning: The team approved the Collaborative VR + web accounts track. AGENT.md and ARCHITECTURE.md allow it as a gated, post-MVP track.

clerk_app_ready.meaning: A Clerk dev instance exists for the web app; the publishable key is known; the web app's dev origin (http://localhost:5173) works; an M2M machine for NemoClaw can be created. The secret key is stored only in the backend environment.

meta_app_ready.meaning: A Meta Horizon developer app exists for the Quest build; App ID noted; App Secret stored only in the backend environment and the Unity dashboard; every tester is added as a test user (needed until the Data Use Checkup is approved).

unity_meta_provider_configured.meaning: Unity Dashboard > Authentication > ID Providers has the Meta Quest (Oculus) provider configured with the Meta App ID and App Secret.

quest_meta_identity_spike_passed.meaning: On a real Quest with a test user: entitlement check passed, GetLoggedInUser returned an ID, two GetUserProof nonces were obtained, SignInWithOculusAsync succeeded with one, and the other validated with is_valid:true at graph.oculus.com/user_nonce_validate (run by the user from a shell with the secret in an env var).

nemoclaw_agent_ready.meaning: Build Plan step 3 is done: NemoClaw runtime running, a read-only scene inspection works, and one tool-calling round trip succeeded on NEMOCLAW_MODEL_PROVIDER=meta (Muse Spark) and on xai (Grok) by changing only the env var.

two_headset_verified.meaning: Step 25 checklist passed on two real headsets plus the web app, including multi-object uploads and a recipient opening a letter live.

gpu_multi_object_verified.meaning: After an approved GPU run: one photo with 3 objects produced 3 PLYs, two uploads submitted together both completed, and the SKETCHSCAPE_GPU_CONCURRENCY benchmark result (or 'kept at 1') is recorded in docs/BUILD_PLAN.md step 27.
